instruction: ARTBOOK FIRST. Treat every existing Web game and daechung-rpg as pre-production/prototype evidence until the initial department artbook gate is complete. Before any formal production or redevelopment continues, planning, development, QA, graphics, and balance must each independently submit one real evidence-based artbook for that game. ChatGPT/director must not author missing department artbooks. Preserve all existing code/build/prototype work as research evidence, but pause formal production progression until all five department artbooks exist and the director only compiles them. After the initial five-artbook gate, each department continues its own weekly artbook submission cadence. Story causality is the primary quality gate: character, monster, boss, environment, quest, combat, progression, UI/intro/audio direction must connect coherently to the story. Existing homepage publication approval remains only for daechung-rpg; do not extend it to other games. Never modify web-games source files and never use paid automation or paid runners.
